title: "About to open a club": Next Gen NYC stars Riley and Georgia get in an argument about being "privileged" - NewsBreak
text: Next Gen NYC Episode 7 saw a conversation between Shai, Riley, and Georgia. It soon became an argument about being "privileged." It started when they were discussing giving feedback about Georgia's idea of starting a new venture, a club. Shai said how they had been dissecting "the most privileged" argument. Listening to the word "privileged," Georgia wasn't happy about Shai's comments. He noted that the fact that she was sitting in a "nice a*s" house for Brooks Marks' birthday, and they were discussing her opening a club. Next Gen NYC star Riley talked about how Georgia was about to start her new venture and said: While in the kitchen, a few of the cast members , including Shai, Riley, Georgia, and more, were casually chatting. Emira and a few others were sitting around listening to the conversations. During one of the conversations, Next Gen NYC star Shai mentioned: As soon as he said "privileged," Georgia jumped in and asked: She added that she "literally" had $4000 in her "bank account privilege." For that, she noted that she had to "work for." Georgia shared her thoughts about being "privileged" and said that it would be if her "daddy" gave her a million dollars. In his private confessional, Next Gen NYC star Shai shared that while Georgia was sitting in a house in Jersey Shore and enjoying a meal from a "private chef," that was "pretty privileged." Shining more light on being "privileged," Riley added that the definition was basically that she had "better than others." Next Gen NYC star Georgia added that she "literally f*cking manifested" a rich boyfriend. Shocked by what she said, Shai was shocked. He said it was "absurd." While Riley was explaining what Shai meant, Georgia got in an argument with her. Riley kept on repeating that she didn't say "privileged," but it was Shai who said it, and Georgia was still sharing her side. The argument escalated, and more cast members, including Ariana, joined it. Seeing her take Georgia's side, Riley was shocked.
